g.text: Blue marks are measured from this fly; orange X marks are constructed rejections. Gate values are read from config/config_new.yaml. Panels with a dashed border are schematic. The video frame is contrast-enhanced (percentile-stretched and gamma-corrected) and shown at its natural, not inverted, polarity.
